children: is facing a tougher setup into the end of 2026, according to KeyBanc Capital Markets, which downgraded the stock to Underweight and cut its price target to $18 as broadband subscriber losses deepen and pressure builds across cable profitability and theme parks.
Analyst Brandon Nispel's new target implies roughly 19% downside from Comcast's latest close.
KeyBanc expects Comcast's domestic broadband net losses to widen to 665,000 in 2027, significantly worse than the consensus estimate for a 482,000 decline.
Competitive pricing is at the center of the problem.

Rivals are offering 1-gigabit internet plans for roughly $30 to $40 per month, leaving Comcast with an uncomfortable choice: avoid matching those promotions and risk losing more customers, or respond with lower pricing and pressure average revenue per user.
That makes the broadband challenge both a subscriber and profitability problem.

Cable and connectivity EBITDA may also struggle to recover as quickly as investors expect. Comcast has described 2026 as a year of investment while undertaking what it has called the largest cost transformation in the company history.
Theme parks add another pressure point.
Universal attendance weakened through August, with total attendance down 3% year over year. Epic Universe's average daily attendance fell to roughly 13,000 from 16,000 in July.
Nispel also sees limited upside from Comcast's planned NBCUniversal spin-off, arguing deteriorating fundamentals and reduced share-repurchase support could offset the potential benefits.
For Comcast investors, the downgrade suggests the stock's low valuation may not be enough to overcome weakening fundamentals.

Comcast trades at roughly 5 times estimated 2027 adjusted EBITDA versus a three-year average near 6 times, but KeyBanc sees further downside because earnings pressure is spreading across multiple businesses.
Investors should watch broadband churn, ARPU, cable EBITDA, park attendance and the economics of the NBCUniversal separation.
The key issue is whether Comcast can stabilize broadband without sacrificing pricing.
Until that becomes clearer, KeyBanc believes the turnaround risk outweighs the apparent valuation discount.

title: KeyBanc Revamps Comcast Stock Price Target for Rest of 2026
